_meta.description: Routing profiles control how the smart router balances quality, speed, and cost. Change 'active' to switch profiles. Weights must sum to 1.0.
_meta.update_reason: Event-driven architecture migration — added model_tiers for 3-tier intelligent routing

performance.description: Best possible results. Ignore cost. Use for critical deliverables.

balanced.description: Smart trade-off between quality, speed, and cost. DEFAULT profile.

cost_saver.description: Minimize variable spend. Use cheapest model that can do the job. Auto-activated at 90% budget.

local_only.description: Ollama only. For offline use, emergencies, or privacy-sensitive tasks.

model_tiers._description: 3-tier intelligent routing. Target split: 50% lightweight / 35% standard / 15% heavy. Agents can override with model_tier field in payload.

lightweight.description: Fastest, cheapest. Health checks, status queries, simple summaries, short cron payloads.
use_when: keywords: [ping, alive, status, check, heartbeat, warmup, warmup]

standard.description: Most agent work: code review, research summaries, planning, analysis.
use_when: agent: eng, research, finance, ops, infosec

heavy.description: Complex reasoning, architecture decisions, L4/L5 approvals, long-form content.
use_when: keywords: [critical, architecture, security review, approval, strategy]

local.description: Free local Ollama. Intent parsing, routing classification, simple classification.

fallback.note: Free tier — 500K tokens/day, 30 req/min. OpenClaw supports Groq for audio only — not wired as auto-fallback. HATAKE falls back to 9router/free-unlimited instead.

tier_classifier._description: Rules for HATAKE/gateway to auto-assign model tier. First match wins.

rules.reason: Long prompts need full context window

prompt_caching._description: Anthropic prompt caching config. Reduces input token cost by 90% on cache hits.
prompt_caching.note: Mark system prompt block with cache_control: {type: 'ephemeral'} in resilient-handler.js

batch_api._description: Use Anthropic Batch API for non-real-time jobs. 50% cost reduction automatically.
batch_api.note: Add 'batch: true' to cron job payload. Gateway routes to Batch API instead of real-time.
